id: title:Gilbert09:stop cold resume read timeouts reporting error tracking noise

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion recovery and regression protection
review.reason: Adds transient retryable classification and test assertion for ClickHouse warehouse ingestion, allowing recovery from cold-start timeouts rather than immediate failure.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies solely on supplied hunk observations; no independent verification of actual production recovery or broader systemic impact.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds 'Read timed out' to the set of retryable connection errors in ClickHouse warehouse source, and adds a corresponding test assertion for the timeout error message.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows ClickHouse warehouse ingestion to recover from transient cold-start timeouts by treating the timeout as a retryable error, relying on Temporal's activity retry to back off and re-establish the connection rather than failing immediately.

observations.behavior: Adds a test assertion checking that the specific timeout error message is recognized as transient and retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the retry behavior of ClickHouse warehouse ingestion when encountering server-side read timeouts.
